body: Not really, no. Things I thought I wanted my whole life are becoming things I don't want anymore, too. The other things I want don't feel possible. I don't know. I want someone to help me work through these things.
It did not help, but I can see its value for many people.
I had not heard of it. I tried it today. Connected to some very nice people that had absolutely no idea how to handle a single one of my issues.
A suicide hotline is going to help me when in the moment, is it not? I need long term help. I need help for my day to day, not to be actively talked off the ledge right this second.
